let _where = { lambda ; a:bool[8,1024] b:i32[8,1024] c:i32[8,1024]. let
    d:i32[8,1024] = select_n a c b
  in (d,) } in
let floor_divide = { lambda ; e:i32[] f:i32[]. let
    g:i32[] = div e f
    h:i32[] = sign e
    i:i32[] = sign f
    j:bool[] = ne h i
    k:i32[] = rem e f
    l:bool[] = ne k 0:i32[]
    m:bool[] = convert_element_type[new_dtype=bool weak_type=False] j
    n:bool[] = convert_element_type[new_dtype=bool weak_type=False] l
    o:bool[] = and m n
    p:i32[] = sub g 1:i32[]
    q:i32[] = jit[
      name=_where
      jaxpr={ lambda ; o:bool[] p:i32[] g:i32[]. let
          q:i32[] = select_n o g p
        in (q,) }
    ] o p g
  in (q,) } in
let remainder = { lambda ; r:i32[] s:i32[]. let
    t:bool[] = eq s 0:i32[]
    u:i32[] = jit[
      name=_where
      jaxpr={ lambda ; t:bool[] v:i32[] s:i32[]. let
          u:i32[] = select_n t s v
        in (u,) }
    ] t 1:i32[] s
    w:i32[] = rem r u
    x:bool[] = ne w 0:i32[]
    y:bool[] = lt w 0:i32[]
    z:bool[] = lt u 0:i32[]
    ba:bool[] = ne y z
    bb:bool[] = and ba x
    bc:i32[] = add w u
    bd:i32[] = select_n bb w bc
  in (bd,) } in
let _pad = { lambda ; be:i32[8,1024] bf:i32[]. let
    bg:i32[] = convert_element_type[new_dtype=int32 weak_type=False] bf
    bh:i32[16,1024] = pad[
      padding_config=((np.int64(0), np.int64(8), 0), (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), 0))
    ] be bg
  in (bh,) } in

      name=_where
